creator: automatedintelligenceai
title: Manus 2.0 and its new 'Cue' app: each agent gets its own email, phone number, wallet and computer; agent group chats; new timeline video editor; prompt-injection warning

tools.name: Cue (Manus app, 'Q')
tools.detail: Gives each agent a real identity: email, phone number, wallet with budget, own computer; forward calls to the agent; group chats; 'Every QR code, an agent'; free with a code (see bio)

tools.name: Manus video editor
tools.detail: Timeline with separate clip/image/text/audio layers; edit then hand back and the agent continues from your edits

tools.name: Manus Build Games / Automations
tools.detail: Feature tiles shown: 'Build Games' with asset grid and a platformer scene, 'Automations'

claims: Until now agents acted through your login/card/inbox so everything bottlenecked on your approval; Cue gives each agent its own email, phone, wallet and computer
Agent pays within a budget you set, takes your phone calls and leaves a summary
Several agents in a group chat with one shared goal hand work to each other (one researches venues, one shortlists, one drafts the deck)
Video editor: previously a change meant rewriting the prompt and regenerating the whole video; now you edit the timeline directly
Four days before launch, researchers showed a hidden instruction in an email could run code inside a Manus environment -- agents with wallets raise the stakes
On-screen stat: 'Average Speedup 8.1%' and 'Average Tokens / Session'
how_to_steps: Get Cue (free with a code from the creator's bio)
Create an agent; it receives its own email, phone number, wallet (set a budget) and computer
Optionally forward your calls to the agent; share agent QR codes; create a group chat of agents with one goal
For video: generate, then open the timeline editor, swap clips/images/text/audio, hand back to the agent
on_screen_only: Panels: 'Average Speedup 8.1%', 'Average Tokens / Session'; 'Agent identity' with agent avatars; 'Create group chat'; 'Forward calls to your agent'; QR code on a 'Lucky Dumpling' restaurant window; 'Saved to your team'
Agents list UI: Lucky Dumpling ('Ready to take your order'), Christine ('Your Resy account is confirm...'), Travel Planner ('Found 3 nonstop flights to To...'), Stay Scout
'Every QR code, an agent.' street scene with Florist / Laundry / Cafe / Bakery agents
Video editor timeline UI ('Untitled video', Media/Text/Graphics/Effects tabs, 'Generating footage')
'Build Games' tile with sprite/asset grid and a snowy platformer scene; 'Automations' tile
cta: 'Q is free with code -- check my bio'

relevance.why: Interesting signal (agent identity + wallet, agent-to-agent group chats) and a sober security note, but Manus is a competing general-agent platform rather than something that improves a Claude Code build workflow. Possibly useful for AI video ads.

implement_score.why: Not worth adopting now: prompt-injection risk with wallets, unclear pricing, and overlaps with what we do in Claude Code. Maybe test the video editor for ad creative later.
